messages:
Molly A.: Quick follow-up from the RFC — we're proposing to replace the old precision flags (use_fp8/use_int8/force_4bit) in the SDK with a single precisionProfile envelope. Want to surface compatibility concerns and rollout plan here.
Kevin L.: Is the idea to keep runtime backwards compatible? lots of customers still on older SDKs.
Molly A.: Yes — runtime will accept both formats. plan: accept old flags, convert server-side to canonical precisionProfile; deprecate flags in SDK v2.0.
Julia P.: How will this affect telemetry? we currently tag traces with the flag names, alerting uses those exact strings.
Raj S.: Also: KV-cache serialization blobs include the precision packing metadata. migration could break hot caches if we change schema without a compatibility shim.
Kevin L.: +1 about cache. Suggest we add a compatibility-header in serialized blobs, e.g. "pp-v1" vs "pp-v2" so older runtimes ignore newer fields.
Molly A.: plan: 1) server accepts both; 2) runtime emits canonical profile and a "source_hint" for back-compat; 3) serialization uses explicit version tag. timeline: feature flag rollout over 4 weeks.
Julia P.: For alerts, we need a migration mapping table so existing dashboards keep firing during rollout. I'll own a phasing doc for metrics.
Raj S.: On quality side: we should gate canaries on per-profile fidelity checks. fp8/int8 swaps can be subtle — add per-profile regression tests and a synthetic prompt suite.
Molly A.: Agreed. proposal: require shadowing for 2 days with computed degeneration score. If deg > threshold, auto-fallback to baseline profile.
Kevin L.: Also need a runtime fallback hint in the API response so client SDKs can display a deprecation warning if they use old flags. minimal surface: add "precision_notice" header.
Julia P.: For per-customer overrides (enterprise), are we keeping the old override keys? customers may have policy-level precision settings.
Molly A.: We'll support customer-level overrides by mapping legacy keys to new profile names. Ops will get a migration runbook.
Raj S.: One more: perf telemetry must keep token-level timings across conversions. Do not double-count tokens that are converted server-side.
Molly A.: noted. ops-bot: deploy scheduled: precision-profile-shim v1 -> staging at 2024-07-18T03:00Z.
ops-bot: Deployment started for precision-profile-shim v1 to staging (build 2024.07.18.1).
Kevin L.: Action items: I will add serialization version header and compatibility tests.
Julia P.: I'll produce the dashboard mapping and synthetic prompt suite.
Raj S.: I'll draft the canary gating thresholds and rollback playbook (include KV-cache eviction steps).
Molly A.: I'll update SDK RFC, draft the deprecation notice copy for customers, and schedule the phasing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
